summary: Full e2e testing of GESOI bilingual landing page (backend + frontend). Backend 6/6 pytest passed (POST/GET /api/contact, EmailStr 422 validation, minimal payload, list, persistence). Frontend passed: hero copy ID/EN toggle, all ecosystem keywords (PERDOSNI/GESOI/otaQku/ICC), join form submission returned POST 200 and displayed success toast ('Terima kasih! Kami akan segera menghubungi Anda.').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string via isoformat() and converts back on read — acceptable, but consider storing native datetime and letting motor serialize; simpler.
No pagination on GET /api/contact (limit 1000). Fine for MVP.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentials with wildcard; not currently used by frontend but worth tightening for production.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed contact submissions via API and UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has POST/GET /api/contact only. All frontend interactive elements have data-testid. Toast library is sonner (bottom-right).
